title: International Space Station
text: The International Space Station (ISS) is a modular space station in low Earth orbit, at an altitude of approximately 400 km. It is a joint project between NASA (US), Roscosmos (Russia), JAXA (Japan), ESA (Europe), and CSA (Canada). Construction began in 1998 and the station has been continuously occupied since November 2, 2000. The ISS orbits Earth every 92 minutes and can be seen from Earth with the naked eye. It has a mass of approximately 420,000 kg and a habitable volume of about 388 cubic meters. Research on the ISS covers biology, physics, astronomy, meteorology, and space medicine, with particular focus on understanding long-duration spaceflight effects on the human body.
